scope: Three included full-text studies in an explicitly bounded accessible corpus; not global prevalence.
rule_order: filter verified use as comparative neural reference
select at most one representative per distinct inductive family if diversity is prioritised
within each family prefer observed recurrence and reproducibility
do not claim minimal measured parameter count when winner configurations are missing

omitted_higher_frequency_candidate.reason: Both LSTM and GRU are recurrent gated-state models; choosing only one makes the three-family diversity rule explicit. This is a trade-off, not proof that GRU is less useful.

limitations: Transformer support is a single grey manuscript; no verified peer-reviewed status.
This trio is not the three most frequent models under frequency alone: GRU is more frequent than TCN/Transformer.
A Transformer encoder has a different asymptotic cost and its simplicity cannot be assumed from frequency.
No exact compact project widths/layers should be invented as if published winners.
No own performance or experimental superiority established.
decision_timing: Rule and trade-offs documented after corpus inspection; not a retrospective claim of preregistration.
